name: pi-vision-struct
description: Layered lossless vision for text-only models (DeepSeek etc.): L0 source (DOM/PPTX) + L1 deterministic measurement (color/OCR/diff/WCAG with exact numbers) + L2 opt-in semantics (local qwen3-vl) + deterministic fusion (crosscheck/audit/rules) + OmniParser icon structuring + CLIP clustering. All local, read-only, schema-driven (vision-report/v2).
